calls.statement:
SELECT 
  dp.sku,
  dp.product_name,
  ROUND((SUM(fsl.gross_amount) - SUM(fsl.standard_cost)) / SUM(fsl.gross_amount) * 100, 2) as gross_margin_pct,
  SUM(fsl.gross_amount) as total_gross_sales,
  SUM(fsl.standard_cost) as total_cost
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE ds.region = 'South'
  AND dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND dd.fiscal_quarter = 4
GROUP BY dp.sku, dp.product_name
ORDER BY gross_margin_pct DESC
LIMIT 10
